【看中国2026年11月18日讯】（看中国记者李净瑶综合报导）中共对台渗透、跨境镇压案件频传，一统及国华征信社业务经理王秉宏受中国上海市公安局官员指示，指派外务员吴泓玮及刘知明长期跟监拍摄反共网红“八炯”温子渝、“闽南狼”陈柏源及其家属，并将情资传交中共官员，新北地检署周二（17日）依违反个资法起诉王男等3人，对王求刑3年6月。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
《自由时报》11月17日报导，检方调查，一统及国华征信社业务经理王秉宏去年3月到中国大陆，结识上海市公安局官员，同年6月起接受中共派遣微信暱称“厦门阿豪”委任，指示调查八炯、闽南狼等人行踪与基本资料。
王秉宏因而利用一统、国华征信社于2020年间向第三方购买、内含台湾全国国民户役政资料的笔记型电脑，非法查得八炯、闽南狼及其父母亲属共7人身分证字号、生日、户籍地、电话及车牌等个资并回传给“厦门阿豪”。
除此之外，王秉宏得知八炯与闽南狼于去年7月12日将在台中市举办“反共护台总动员”公民晚会，随即指派吴泓玮及刘知明两人至餐厅及住处等非公开场合跟监拍摄并回传照片。同年10月2日，王接获“厦门阿豪”通知，指闽南狼将出席北市圆山大饭店的“国际反共保台行动大会”，再度指派吴前往现场跟监拍摄。
检警查到，王秉宏同年11月4日至6日再次赴中国大陆，当面将个资和跟监拍的照片交给上海市公安局官员。随后，福建省泉州市公安局即于11月13日发布悬赏通告，以涉“煽动分裂国家行为”实施终生通缉，祭出人民币5万元至25万元悬赏金，征集犯罪线索。
网红八炯表示，“我认为他们可能今年才开始做这件事情，结果没想到去年我被通缉之前，他就开始在做这个跟监、跟拍的事情，我觉得比较担心的是，现在好像看到谁都要防了。”
八炯11月17日在其脸书粉专发贴表示，“你可以不认同八炯，但任何人都不该因为表达立场，就连累家人遭到这种对待。今天被盯上的是我们，这种手段若被放任，谁能保证没有下一个？”他呼吁大家帮忙分享，让更多人看见：“中共的跨境镇压，已经伸进台湾。”
网红闽南狼指出，“中共通缉出来之后，平常走在路上都会紧张了，现在又真的看到有人这样做，而且拍摄距离又那么近，无法就是用形容词表达这种恐惧，因为这件事情让我就是身边的亲朋好友也都会保持距离。”
此案由检察官陈香君、陈致廷指挥调查局国安站、新北市刑大、中和警分局于7月发动搜索，讯后王秉宏遭声押禁见。当时还约谈了“征信教父”之称的一统及国华征信创办人赵维君、一统征信总经理赵柏凯等10名被告，讯后谕知赵维君300万元交保、赵柏凯150万元交保。被约谈的10名被告当中，王秉宏、吴泓玮及刘知明被起诉，其余赵维君等人另案侦办中。
检方指出，王秉宏前后供词避重就轻、心态并非真心悔悟；审酌其身为征信业者，明知中共对台湾进行言论打压及跨境镇压，仍为图利而组成跟监组织，泄漏个资致国人遭红色通缉、身心受创，严重危害国家安全潜在威胁，求处3年6月徒刑。
至于吴泓玮及刘知明两人，因庭讯时深知对被害人隐私权造成侵害并深表悔悟、非始作俑者，建请法院量处适当之刑。至于3人被控违反“国安法”为境外敌对势力传递公务应秘密资料罪嫌，检察官认为，本案被搜集的个资难认与国家政务、国安边防等应保守公务秘密具利害关系。
检方呼吁，民众切勿受利益诱惑而接受境外势力指示，从事侵害民众基本权利或危害国家安全的行为。针对境外势力透过境内协力者，非法监控、搜集国人个资，或恫吓、打压台湾人民等犯罪行为，检方强调绝不容忍，将依法严查究办、绝不宽贷，并持续与司法警察及国安机关合作，积极防制跨境镇压。
中共对台渗透的攻势不断，不仅派人跟监情蒐，也吸收台湾军人充当内应。《公视新闻》11月17日报导，退伍宪兵少校李贤达与空军女士兵森慧姿因急需用钱，被吸收沦共谍，涉泄露多件军事机密资料给中共。法院于11月17日开庭审理此案。
这起共谍官司，包含陆军、空军、宪兵、海巡有4人被起诉。除了李贤达与森慧姿外，另两人为蔡姓海巡女军官，以及国防部后指部前上尉尤正宇。他们皆被控在职时期，涉嫌泄漏军事机密，大赚不法利益。检方调查发现，李贤达获取88万4千元，森慧姿与蔡女共获利51万5千元，尤正宇获得43万余元，四人不法所得共计182万余元，涉犯《国安法》等罪嫌，由于全案属于机密案件，采取不公开审理。

台湾数位部发展部统计，近期已有10余家企业与机构遭骇，外泄个资约达800万笔。（示意图来源：Chesnot／Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月18日讯】（看中国记者李净瑶综合报导）台湾数位部发展部统计，近期已有10余家企业与机构遭骇，外泄个资约达800万笔。其中受波及的外交部领事事务局，据称超过7万张护照大头照以及2.6万份授权书扫描档外泄。行政院周三（18日）正式发函各部会，要求发生个资外泄的企业及机构，立即依《个人资料保护法》规定主动通知当事人。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
中央社11月18日报导，近期台湾资安事故频传，包括易游网、永丰银、91APP、外交部领事事务局、台北市工务局大地处脸书粉丝专页等均一度遭骇，引发关注。
其中受波及的外交部领事事务局，据称超过7万张护照大头照以及2.6万份授权书扫描档外泄。领务局11月12日致歉并说明相关网站经修复已恢复上线，遭窃资料不影响已核发护照与授权书效力，民众无须立即换发护照。
台湾立法院交通委员会11月18日审查2027年度中央政府总预算案关于数位发展部数位产业署单位预算，邀请数位发展部长林宜敬列席备询。
国民党立委万美玲指出，领务局在4日发现部分网站疑似遭到骇客入侵，遭窃资料包含民众护照的大头照，高达7万2702个档案，以及驻纽约办事处部分授权书的扫描档2万6072笔等资料，不知道数发部是否有去了解，是网站存在漏洞，还是委外厂商未依契约履行资安的相关防护措施。
林宜敬表示，就他的了解，遭骇的是领务局网站，不是外交部本部的网站。而发生问题的原因是委外厂商在进行系统更新时，有一个设定错误，等于是原来没有问题的部分，因为设定错误而产生了一个新的漏洞。他说，“骇客则是利用AI工具扫描，在发现这个漏洞后，就侵入到领务局的系统中，并拿走一些资料。”
针对资安事件连环爆，台湾当局采取了应对措施。行政院18日透过新闻稿指出，数位发展部统计资料显示，近期已有10余家企业、机构爆发重大资安事件，外泄个资约800万笔。
行政院表示，已发函促请相关部会督促所涉企业、机构，依个人资料保护法第12条及施行细则第22条规定，即时以言词、书面、电话、简讯、电子邮件、传真、电子文件或其他方式，通知资料被外泄当事人；并建议同时于官网首页、APP或实体店面等处张贴醒目公告，明确提醒民众可能之诈骗手法与风险。
行政院提醒，民众千万要提高警觉，就算诈骗集团轻易说出你的身分证字号、出生年月日、住址等个资也不要惊慌，不要被诈骗集团话术带着走，立刻挂断电话、拨打165反诈骗专线求证，并随时注意企业机构官网首页、APP或实体店面公告，保护个人财产安全。
鉴于骇客利用AI自动化攻击盗取个资已成趋势，这种以机器速度运作的攻击浪潮已造成全球多国政府与企业大量个资外泄。台湾金管会11月12日召开今年第二次金融资安长联系会议，并于13日发布新闻稿，要求银行、证券期货与保险业落实6项重点措施，因应新兴AI攻击风险。
这6项措施是：优先修补对外曝露、已被利用的重大弱点；强化资料、交易与高风险权限的授权检查与异常侦测；审慎评估导入防御型AI；透过F-ISAC等机制分享情资，并管好共用供应商与云端服务；演练AI攻击、委外厂商中断等情境的备援与复原；由董事会与高阶主管把AI与资安风险纳入整体治理。
金管会强调，这不只是资讯或资安单位的工作，资安长需要足够的人力、预算与技术资源。

电影“大蒙”导演陈玉勋出席第12届亚洲国际电影节红毯活动。（图片来源：中央社）
【看中国2026年11月18日讯】电影“大蒙”代表台湾角逐2027年奥斯卡最佳国际影片，导演陈玉勋在洛杉矶受访表示，拍摄这部以白色恐怖为背景的电影，希望让下一代了解台湾的过去，“我们要了解历史的真相，才知道未来应该怎么走”。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
第12届亚洲国际电影节（Asian World Film Festival）12日至19日在洛杉矶地区举行，“大蒙”与“她的碎片”、“螳螂”及“自主挥棒”等多部作品在“聚焦台湾”单元放映，导演陈玉勋与监制李烈、叶如芬出席红毯、映后活动，接受中央社记者访问。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
“大蒙”故事背景为1950年代白色恐怖时期，当时政府以涉嫌叛乱、匪谍等罪名大规模逮捕、处决政治异议人士。“大蒙”故事透过小人物的遭遇，呈现威权统治下的社会与生活。
陈玉勋过去执导“总铺师”、“消失的情人节”，擅长幽默风格，这次转而挑战沉重的历史题材，他向中央社记者表示：“人生本来没有这个计划，但是年纪大了，看了很多资料，好像有一股力量带着我写出这个剧本。”
陈玉勋表示：“我们必须了解过去的历史真相，才知道未来应该怎么走。尤其是给年轻人、我们的下一代看，让他们知道祖先是怎么过来的。”
陈玉勋与监制李烈、叶如芬此行在洛杉矶参加电影节，向美国电影工作者介绍这部作品，为明年3月的第99届奥斯卡金像奖铺路。“大蒙”在去年金马奖获得最佳剧情片等4项大奖，影迷期待挑战更高殿堂，陈玉勋笑说：“我没有想那么多。”
曾参与“返校”制作的监制李烈，这次再度投入白色恐怖题材。她表示，自己成长的年代，学校历史课本很少介绍台湾这段历史，这也是她持续制作相关电影的原因。
李烈说：“我们既然是生在台湾、长在台湾，我们一定有必要知道这块土地上曾经发生过什么事情。”她认为，让下一代、下下一代的年轻人知道这些历史，是非常重要的事。
李烈表示，电影工作者负责传递讯息，观众若希望进一步了解历史细节，如今网络资讯发达，可以自行搜寻更多相关故事。
这部作品为了重现70多年前的台湾社会，面临许多挑战，监制叶如芬指出，台湾拍摄场地有限，缺乏足够的影视基地，要还原1950年代的街道与生活场景，难度相当高。
她表示，剧组利用台南岸内影视基地，获得文化部及台南市政府文化局支持，从建筑、美术、服装到造型，尽可能重现当年的台湾，包括台北过去的违章建筑，电影中阿月下火车后所见的街道景象。
叶如芬表示，台湾地方虽小，但电影人才很优秀，团队从资料搜集到实际制作，想尽办法克服困难。她认为，台湾电影持续在进步，不断与韩国、日本、美国及东南亚等地的工作人员交流，最近两三年有许多优秀的类型片作品。
2025年11月22日，在台北举行的第62届金马奖颁奖典礼上，台湾导演陈玉勋（左）凭借电影《大蒙》获得最佳剧情片奖后，与剧组人员合影。（图片来源：I-Hwa Cheng / AFP via Getty Images)

## 2026年11月18日星期三

### 福建人权捍卫者王秀英被以涉嫌“寻衅滋事罪”刑事拘留

[](https://lingbaxianzhang.blogspot.com/2026/11/blog-post_150.html)（维权网信息中心报道）2026 年 11 月 16 日，本网获悉：2026 年 11 月 9 日，福建人权捍卫者王秀英在北京被以涉嫌“寻衅滋事罪”刑事拘留，目前羁押在北京市房山区看守所。
王秀英长期为村民集体土地权益维权，通过诉讼、信访等途径寻求救济，曾公开发表《福建省福安市失地农民维权宣言》，批评地方政府及法院。

今年 8 月，她曾因信访记录在北京遭警方反复盘查。

新的 EggStreme 恶意软件变体在政府攻击中悄无声息地逃避安全工具
新的 EggStreme 恶意软件变体在政府攻击中悄无声息地逃避安全工具
Ravie Lakshmanan着2026年11月18日网络间谍/恶意软件
复杂的 EggStreme 恶意软件背后疑似中国的高级持续威胁 (APT) 组织已经重建了其工具包，继续针对菲律宾的政府组织。
Bitdefender 在与《黑客新闻》分享的一份技术报告中表示：“当攻击者暴露时，廉价的应对措施就是轮换。” “文件哈希值会随着每次重新编译而改变，一个域名花费几美元，而一个新的 IP 地址花费更少。”
“EggStreme 操作员所做的不仅仅是轮换，我们现在看到的代理使用不同的网络协议，具有增强的命令集，并且采用永远不会发出信标的被动变体。基础设施似乎正在摆脱将旧服务器捆绑在一起的单一证书颁发机构。”
最终结果是，这些更改使其能够绕过 2025 年 9 月首次曝光时围绕 EggStreme 恶意软件框架构建的静态签名和启发式检测。
EggStreme 的定义特征是通过未知的初始访问向量交付，使用 DLL 侧面加载来执行有效负载。它具有多个组件，如下所示 -
EggStremeFuel（又名 RawCookie），用于进行系统分析并部署 EggStremeLoader
EggStremeLoader，设置持久化并解密执行EggStremeReflectiveLoader
EggStremeReflectiveLoader，执行 EggStremeAgent
EggStremeAgent（又名 Gorem RAT），核心组件和全功能后门，可通过名为 EggStremeKeylogger 的注入键盘记录器实现系统侦察、横向移动、数据盗窃，并通过名为 EggStremeWizard 的辅助后门实现反向 shell 和文件上传/下载功能
值得注意的是，该框架的一些组件（例如 EggStremeFuel 和 EggStremeLoader）已在 2025 年 3 月至 9 月期间被 Palo Alto Networks 跟踪的另一个集群 CL-STA-1048 投入使用。
Bitdefender 技术解决方案总监 Martin Zugec 告诉《黑客新闻》，CL-STA-1048 针对东南亚政府实体及其相关工具“与我们观察到的情况一致”，但强调他们的研究更关注恶意软件的功能及其演变，而不是归因。
Zugec 指出，与中国相关活动的常见情况一样，相同的工具可以被多个威胁行为者使用，并补充说，他们没有比较基础设施或受害者数据来确定这两组活动是否构成与 CL-STA-1048 相同的威胁集群。
Bitdefender 的最新发现显示了 EggStreme 功能的重大重组，包括从此后观察到的每个代理构建中删除键盘记录器。在公开披露后的两周内，据说威胁行为者还做出了其他改变——
EggStremeFuel 用于保护其配置的方法
EggStremeLoader 的加密和有效负载格式，到 2025 年 10 月末从 RC4 迁移到 RC5，并迁移到自定义密码
在 EggStremeAgent 中添加了命令，以促进 Active Directory 侦察、Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) 查询、TCP 流量转发以及 PowerShell、可移植可执行文件 (PE)、.NET 程序集有效负载的执行
从单一证书颁发机构转向特定于活动的证书

New EggStreme Malware Variant Goes Silent to Evade Security Tools in Government Attacks
New EggStreme Malware Variant Goes Silent to Evade Security Tools in Government Attacks
Ravie LakshmananNov 18, 2026Cyber Espionage / Malware
The suspected Chinese advanced persistent threat (APT) group behind the sophisticated EggStreme malware has rebuilt its toolkit as it continues to target government organizations in the Philippines.
"When attackers are exposed, the cheap response is to rotate," Bitdefender said in a technical report shared with The Hacker News. "A file hash changes with every recompile, a domain costs a few dollars, and a new IP address costs less."
"The EggStreme operators did more than rotate – the agent we now see uses a different network protocol, has an enhanced command set, and comes in a passive variant that never beacons out. The infrastructure appears to be moving away from the one certificate authority that tied its older servers together."
The end result is that the changes allow it to bypass static signatures and heuristic detections built around the EggStreme malware framework when it was first exposed in September 2025.
Delivered via an as-yet-unknown initial access vector, EggStreme's defining characteristic is the use of DLL sideloading to execute payloads. It features multiple components as follows -
EggStremeFuel (aka RawCookie), which conducts system profiling and deploys EggStremeLoader
EggStremeLoader, which sets up persistence and decrypts and executes EggStremeReflectiveLoader
EggStremeReflectiveLoader, which executes EggStremeAgent
EggStremeAgent (aka Gorem RAT), the core component and a full-featured backdoor that enables system reconnaissance, lateral movement, data theft via an injected keylogger called EggStremeKeylogger, and reverse shell and file upload/download capabilities via a secondary backdoor called EggStremeWizard
It's worth noting that some components of the framework, such as EggStremeFuel and EggStremeLoader, have been put to use by another cluster tracked by Palo Alto Networks as CL-STA-1048 between March and September 2025.
Martin Zugec, technical solutions director at Bitdefender, told The Hacker News that CL-STA-1048's targeting of a Southeast Asian government entity and its associated tooling is "consistent with what we have observed" but emphasized that their research is more focused on the malware's capabilities and its evolution rather than attribution.
As is often the case with Chinese-aligned activity, the same tools can be used by more than one threat actor, Zugec noted, adding they have not compared infrastructure or victim data to determine if the two sets of activity constitute the same threat cluster as CL-STA-1048.
The latest findings from Bitdefender show a significant retooling of EggStreme's capabilities, including removing the keylogger from every agent build observed since then. Within two weeks after public disclosure, the threat actors are also said to have made other changes -
The method EggStremeFuel uses to protect its configuration
EggStremeLoader's cryptography and payload format, moving from RC4 to RC5 and to a custom cipher by the end of October 2025
Added commands in EggStremeAgent that facilitate Active Directory reconnaissance, Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) querying, TCP traffic forwarding, and execution of PowerShell, Portable Executable (PE), .NET assembly payloads
Moving from a single certificate authority to campaign-specific certificate authorities
In addition, where lateral movement previously relied on Impacket-like tooling and on EggStremeAgent itself, newer incidents make use of an unmanaged system that sits outside of the organization's endpoint management but is still reachable by other workstations to stage the payloads and launch them via DLL sideloading using a Visual Basic Script (VBScript) file remotely run over Server Message Block (SMB).
Exactly how the operators gain access to the target is still unclear. "Our first investigation began with a logon script on a network share, and we could not determine how that script got there," Zugec said. "In the later activity we analyzed, the operators used valid credentials and a script staged on a host that the organization did not manage. That tells us how they moved once inside, not how they got in."
Some of the newer builds have been found to run in passive mode by opening a listening port and waiting for the operator to connect in as opposed to contacting an external command-and-control (C2) server.
Bitdefender also noted that there is no evidence at this stage to indicate EggStremeWizard has been discontinued by the attackers.
"The newer EggStremeAgent samples we analyzed do not show whether it is still being deployed because it is not part of the agent," Zugec said. "EggStremeWizard was an additional tool used alongside EggStremeAgent, not the primary implant, and the framework works without it. The keylogger is a separate component. Its absence from the newer agent builds reflects what the operators chose to compile into those builds, so we do not interpret its absence as evidence that the tool has been retired."
There is also some evidence that the attackers have also targeted Taiwan, but it has been treated with low to medium confidence.
"The speed of the loader changes says as much about the operators' maturity as about the cost of exposure," Bitdefender concluded. "The build-time design appears to be what makes rebuilds this fast. What they did not change is how they operate: sideloaded DLLs under system library names, staging through file shares, running from memory, and requiring mutual TLS."
Mustang Panda Targets Philippine Government Using ASEAN Summit Lures
As of late October 2026, Philippine government officials have also been targeted by Mustang Panda, a prolific China-aligned cyber espionage group, using ASEAN Summit lures to deliver PlugX using established tactics like DLL sideloading.
"The package impersonated a Laos–Philippines bilateral meeting agenda from the Lao Ministry of Foreign Affairs," Dream Research Labs said in a report published last week.
"It named five officials and referenced plausible diplomatic priorities, requesting that the reader provide confirmation before the summit. Behind it was a delivery chain that installed PlugX remote-access malware while displaying the decoy agenda."
Earth Alux Uses Stealthy Tradecraft to Strike Southeast Asia
The disclosure comes as a China-nexus threat actor tracked as Earth Alux (aka Ink Dragon, Jewelbug, REF7707, and UAT-11587) has been attributed to a fresh set of attacks targeting Southeast Asian government entities since at least July 2025. Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 has assigned the activity the designation TGR-STA-0049 (formerly CL-STA-0049).
"The defining signature of the threat actor behind the activity is the targeting of government entities, combined with the use of advanced custom payloads that are designed for high-stealth intelligence collection operations, with an emphasis on evading security detection tools," Unit 42 researcher Tom Fakterman said.
Attacks mounted by the group have historically deployed an advanced backdoor known as FINALDRAFT (aka Squidoor) since 2023. However, it has since expanded its malware arsenal to include two previously undocumented remote access trojans (RATs) called PerfectPioneer RAT (in July 2025) and KUKURAT (in March 2026).
Initial access to target networks is achieved via exploitation of vulnerable, unpatched Microsoft Exchange servers to deploy web shells like ASPXSpy and Godzilla, which are then used to deploy the RAT payloads. Alternatively, Earth Alux has leveraged phishing emails using decoy PDFs and lookalike domains to compromise victim hosts.
PerfectPioneer RAT is a Go-based malware that's launched via three different methods -
DLL sideloading to launch a malicious DLL that reads, decrypts and executes XOR-encrypted shellcode containing the RAT
Decoy installers for Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect that installs the legitimate program but also writes the malware to disk and executes it in the background
Disguising executable files as PDF documents in phishing emails that, once launched, opens a decoy PDF document while the malware is launched in the background
The malware supports a number of features that enable the operator to gain remote control of the infected host. It facilitates file operations, shell execution, process management, keylogging, SOCKS5 proxy, screenshot capture, Window enumeration and manipulation, and CPU and memory utilization monitoring.
It also ensures a connection to the C2 server remains active at all times and systematically cleans up temporary files and runs garbage collection if memory usage exceeds 100 MB to minimize forensic traces.
Furthermore, select variants of the malware come with an "isDangerousCommand" feature to avoid running administrative commands that would be highly destructive or noisy, thereby allowing it to be detected by security programs installed on the host. These include rm, curl | bash, wget | bash, and powershell -e, among others.
KUKURAT, in contrast, functions as a modular implant that's executed in networks already compromised by PerfectPioneer RAT. Written in C++, the backdoor implements its functionality as a separate DLL module that's loaded dynamically at runtime directly from the C2 server.
This allows the malware to be highly evasive and adapt its capabilities on the fly in response to shifting operational objectives. It supports the following features -
Send system information and receive a configuration from the C2 server
Execute shell commands via cmd.exe and PowerShell
Ensure the malware remains active by means of a standalone watchdog executable
What's more, KUKURAT initiates bogus, legitimate-looking activity on the endpoint to camouflage and cover up its tracks based on a command issued by the threat actor. This includes -
Generate 10 decoy HTTP requests per operational cycle to randomly selected domains that are extracted from a hard-coded list of 15 popular websites using randomly generated URL paths with an aim to blend C2 communications
Mimic legitimate Google Chrome browser behavior by writing random data to the registry path HKCU\Software\Google\Chrome\BrowserCrashRecovery, reading the data back, and deleting the key
Create temporary files with random names and randomized content inside the system %temp% directory, and delete them
"Both PerfectPioneer RAT and KUKURAT use HTTP/3 as the primary method for communicating with C2 infrastructure," Unit 42 said. "While the adoption of HTTP/3 is rare across the broader malware landscape, its deployment in this campaign reflects an emerging trend among advanced threat actors."
The attacks have also been found to leverage established tools like PsExec, WMI, and Windows Remote Management (WinRM) to move laterally across compromised enterprise networks; collect credentials using Mimikatz, ProcDump, and SharpDPAPI; compromise Domain Controllers to deploy KUKURAT on local endpoints; and exfiltrate sensitive data such as files and emails.
"Through the deployment of KUKURAT and the PerfectPioneer RAT, the attackers behind this activity are actively evolving to stay ahead of traditional network defenses by implementing protocol-level evasion via HTTP/3 and QUIC over UDP," Unit 42 concluded.
"What makes this group particularly evasive is the extensive effort invested in maintaining operational security and remaining hidden on compromised endpoints. The group demonstrates a mature understanding of modern defensive ecosystems. They have even gone so far as to embed hard-coded administrative safety switches within their binaries to prevent their own operators from running loud or destructive commands that might trigger security alerts."

星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
赛马会启德水上活动中心在香港开幕
香港首个综合城市社区水上运动中心于周三开业。该设施获赛马会慈善信托基金捐赠港币 8,200 万港元，在前启德消防局提供龙舟、皮划艇、帆船及陆上活动，并设有无障碍设施，为市民提供无障碍通道。
周三，香港赛马会启德水上活动中心正式开幕，标志着香港的一个重要里程碑。新设施得到香港赛马会慈善信托基金向香港水上运动慈善信托基金捐款逾8,200万港元的支持，成为香港首个位于市区的综合社区水上运动中心。
该中心由香港水上运动协会管理，提供独特的水上和陆上活动融合，为居民和游客提供一个新的休闲目的地。该中心位于前启德消防局的场地上，对一栋 1970 年代历史悠久的两层建筑进行了活化。该设施提供广泛的娱乐选择，包括龙舟、皮划艇、划船、帆船、风帆冲浪、救生、尾流冲浪和陆地活动。它还具有无障碍通道，确保残疾人士的机会。
开幕典礼吸引多位知名人士出席，包括香港赛马会董事、立法会议员霍启刚；康乐及文化事务署署长陈咏文；消防处助理处长张裕觉；及香港水上运动发展局主席迈克尔·丹纳。
霍英东表示，自2025年7月推出“赛马会乘浪社区计划”及中心于2026年4月试运行以来，参与人数已超过35,000人次。他希望该设施有助将九龙东打造成充满活力的水上运动中心，并巩固香港作为大型国​​际体育赛事举办地的声誉。
该设施还辅以赛马会乘风破浪社区计划，该计划与体育协会和非政府组织合作，提供水上运动训练、促进水上安全并鼓励整个社区健康、积极的生活方式。该计划包括证书课程、学校外展和团体培训，为学校和社区团体提供全额资助的机会。我们特别关注贫困青少年、低收入家庭、残疾人和其他服务不足的群体。

Thursday, 19 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Jockey Club Kai Tak Water Sports Centre opens in Hong Kong
Hong Kong’s first integrated urban community water sports centre opened on Wednesday. Supported by a HK$82 million donation from the Jockey Club Charities Trust, the facility offers dragon boating, kayaking, sailing and land activities at the former Kai Tak Fire Station, with barrier-free access for
Hong Kong marked a significant milestone on Wednesday with the official opening of the Jockey Club Kai Tak Water Sports Centre. Supported by a donation of over HK$82 million from The Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust to the Hong Kong Water Sports Charitable Trust, the new facility is the city's first integrated community water sports centre in an urban setting.
Managed by the Hong Kong Water Sports Council, the centre offers a unique blend of water and land-based activities, providing residents and visitors with a new recreational destination. Situated on the grounds of the former Kai Tak Fire Station, the centre has revitalised a historic two-storey building from the 1970s. The facility offers a broad spectrum of recreational options, including dragon boating, kayaking, rowing, sailing, windsurfing, lifesaving, wake surfing, and land-based activities. It also features barrier-free access, ensuring opportunities for people with disabilities.
The opening ceremony drew several prominent figures, including Steward of The Hong Kong Jockey Club and lawmaker Kenneth Fok Kai-kong; director of Leisure and Cultural Services Manda Chan Wing-man; assistant director of Fire Services Cheu Yu-kok; and chairman of the Hong Kong Water Sports Council Michael Tanner.
Fok noted that since the launch of the Jockey Club Ride the Wave Community Programme in July 2025 and the centre’s trial run in April 2026, there have been over 35,000 participant visits. He hoped the facility would help transform Kowloon East into a vibrant water sports hub and reinforce Hong Kong’s reputation as a venue for major international sporting events.
The facility is complemented by the Jockey Club Ride the Wave Community Programme, which partners with sports associations and NGOs to provide water sports training, promote water safety, and encourage healthy, active lifestyles across the community. The programme features certificate courses, school outreach, and group training, with fully funded opportunities available for schools and community groups. Special attention is given to underprivileged youth, low-income families, people with disabilities, and other underserved groups.

香港食环署公厕荣获两项大奖 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港食环署公厕荣获两项大奖
香港食物环境卫生署的两个公厕荣获金奖和铜奖。位于观塘的金奖厕所采用受水母启发的模块化设计、智能监控系统和事故检测功能。该部门计划翻新所有剩余的公共设施
香港食物环境卫生署（食环署）于2026年11月18日公布公厕荣获两项奖项。观塘的公厕荣获金奖，南区的公厕荣获铜奖。
观塘区鲤鱼门（岭南新村）金奖厕所采用了「厕所一代PT 2.0公厕设计比赛」的设计理念。受水母的启发，模块化结构适应不同的地形和环境。厕所内部宽敞，设有带自动门的无障碍厕所、通用厕所、外部设有饮水机。它配备了智能监测系统，可实时检测气味并自动报告，以及非接触式反馈系统。无障碍厕所还具有智能事故检测系统，可以识别跌倒或异常停留情况。
位于南区香港仔道的铜奖厕所经过翻新，以温暖的大地色调和简洁的线条呈现现代美感。它包括供儿童和老年用户使用的设施，以适应不同年龄段的需求。

Hong Kong FEHD wins two awards for public toilets | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 19 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong FEHD wins two awards for public toilets
Hong Kong's Food and Environmental Hygiene Department won gold and bronze awards for two public toilets. The gold-winning toilet in Kwun Tong features a modular design inspired by jellyfish, smart monitoring systems, and accident detection. The department plans to renovate all remaining public toile
The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD) of Hong Kong has won two awards for public toilets, the department announced on 18 November 2026. A toilet in Kwun Tong received a gold award and a toilet in Southern District received a bronze award.
The gold-winning toilet at Lei Yue Mun (Lingnan New Village) in Kwun Tong District adopted a design concept from the 'Toilet Generation PT 2.0 Public Toilet Design Competition'. Inspired by a jellyfish, the modular structure adapts to different terrains and environments. The toilet features spacious interiors, an accessible toilet with an automatic door, a general-use toilet, and a drinking fountain outside. It is equipped with a smart monitoring system that detects odours in real time and automatically reports them, as well as a contactless feedback system. The accessible toilet also has an intelligent accident detection system that identifies falls or abnormal stays.
The bronze-winning toilet at Aberdeen Road in Southern District was renovated with warm earth tones and clean lines, offering a modern aesthetic. It includes facilities for children and elderly users to accommodate different age groups.
A department spokesman said: 'FEHD has been adopting a multi-pronged approach, including introducing new technology, to enhance the facilities, management and hygiene standards of its public toilets, and to cater for the needs of different users in the design. The repeated awards for our public toilets reflect the recognition of our continuous efforts to improve public toilet services, which is encouraging. Maintaining clean and comfortable public toilets also depends on the dedicated cleaning and management by frontline staff, and we thank them for their contributions.'
FEHD earlier noted odour issues at Chai Wan Kok public toilet in Tsuen Wan District and promptly informed relevant departments for repairs. The department has placed temporary toilets nearby and will enhance cleaning of these units until repairs are completed. FEHD also requested that relevant departments expedite repairs. To improve facilities at Tai Kiu Village public toilet and Tong Chau Street public toilet, FEHD has included both in a renovation plan, requiring contractors to strengthen cleaning and closely monitoring their performance.
FEHD currently manages over 800 public toilets. Since 2019, it has worked with the Architectural Services Department on an upgrade and renovation programme. Before the programme, about 110 toilets had already been renovated. Of the remaining approximately 700 toilets covered by the programme, nearly 85 per cent have started renovation, with over 250 completed. The department aims to begin renovation work on all remaining about 110 toilets by the end of 2028.
Adopting recommendations from a consultant report by the City University of Hong Kong, FEHD has since 2023 implemented a 1:2.32 male-to-female toilet stall ratio standard for new or renovated toilets with high usage. For low-usage or remote toilets, the ratio is adjusted flexibly based on site conditions, space constraints and operational needs.

最后一场幻彩咏香江表演吸引大批观众前往香港维多利亚港 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
最后一场幻彩咏香江表演吸引大批观众前往香港维多利亚港
香港已有22年历史的幻彩咏香江晚会于11月18日举行了最后一场演出，吸引了大量观众前往维多利亚港。超过 40 座建筑参与其中，并为告别表演增添了烟花。
已有22年历史的《幻彩咏香江》于11月18日晚上8点举行最后一场演出，吸引大批观众前往维多利亚港。沿海港的 40 多座建筑，包括中环广场、会展中心和国际金融中心两座塔楼，灯光与音乐同步，进行了约 10 分钟的展示。一些建筑物还为告别表演燃放烟花。
晚上7点左右，尖沙咀天星码头已挤满了携带相机记录这一事件的居民和游客。一位奥地利游客表示，他是通过社交媒体了解到最后一场演出的，并且是第一次观看。 “我真的很期待，”他说。
一位当地居民表示，得知这是《幻彩咏香江》最后一场演出后，他于下午 6 点抵达。 “我想见证结局，”他说，并补充说他特别期待最后一场演出中添加烟花元素。
一位同样提前到达的中国大陆游客表示，她是专程来看展览的。 “我以前从未见过，我真的很期待。我相信整个演出将会非常精彩。”她说。

Last Symphony of Lights show draws large crowds to Hong Kong's Victoria Harbour
Hong Kong's 22-year-old Symphony of Lights show held its final performance on 18 November, drawing large crowds to Victoria Harbour. Over 40 buildings participated, with fireworks added for the farewell show.
The 22-year-old Symphony of Lights show held its final performance at 8pm on 18 November, drawing large crowds to Victoria Harbour. More than 40 buildings along the harbour, including Central Plaza, the Convention and Exhibition Centre, and the two International Finance Centre towers, synchronised their lights with music for the approximately 10-minute display. Some buildings also set off fireworks for the farewell show.
By around 7pm, the Star Ferry pier in Tsim Sha Tsui was already crowded with residents and tourists carrying cameras to record the event. An Austrian tourist said he had learned about the final show through social media and was watching it for the first time. 'I'm really looking forward to it,' he said.
A local resident said he had arrived at 6pm after learning it was the last Symphony of Lights performance. 'I want to witness the end,' he said, adding that he was particularly looking forward to the fireworks element being added for the final show.
A mainland Chinese tourist who also arrived early said she had come specially to see the display. 'I've never seen it before, I'm really looking forward to it. I'm sure the whole show will be very spectacular,' she said.

香港教育局长概述成为顶级国际留学目的地的战略 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港教育局长概述成为顶级国际留学目的地的战略
香港教育局局长详细介绍了吸引更多非本地学生、通过北领地大学城提升大学容量以及扩大“留学香港”品牌的详细计划。目标包括到 2027/28 年将非本地学生人数增加至 90,000 人。
香港教育局局长概述了政府深化香港国际教育中心地位的战略，旨在使其成为全球学生的首选。局长于2026年11月18日在立法会发表讲话，详细阐述了多管齐下的措施，包括扩大大学能力、加强支持系统以及推广“留学香港”品牌。
在港就读的非本地学生人数由2023/24学年的23,100人大幅增加至2025/26学年的30,400人，来自100多个国家和地区。正如《2026 年施政报告》所述，政府设定了到 2026/27 学年将这一数字增加至约 90,000 人的目标。
主要举措包括成立专门的“留港留学”专责小组，协调政府各决策局和部门的工作。政府还推出“留学香港”和“游学香港”品牌，首届“留学香港周”和举办APAIE 2026会议等，吸引了来自72个国家的3,500多名国际教育领袖参加。
为了支持这一增长，政府正在扩大奖学金项目，特别是“一带一路”奖学金，该奖学金将从最初的 10 个奖项增加到 2027/28 学年每年 200 个。住宿问题正在通过“校园城”计划解决，截至 2026 年 10 月下旬，该计划已批准 45 份将商业建筑改造成学生宿舍的申请，预计将提供约 11,450 个床位。
简化短期课程的签证程序，入境事务处已向非中国籍香港居民发放超过53,500份多次入境签证，以方便其前往中国内地，促进学术交流。政府还将IANG（非本地毕业生移民安排）计划的居留期从12个月延长至24个月，以帮助留住人才。
该战略的一个主要组成部分是北领地大学城，占地1,000多公顷，横跨新田、洪水桥和打鼓岭。洪水桥的三个校区现已开放接受合资格院校的申请。政府将指导委员会升级为“大学城发展建设委员会”，由布政司领导，负责监督进展情况。
“留学香港”品牌也正在延伸至基础教育领域。于2026/27学年推出的“直接资助扩展”试点计划，允许合资格的直接资助计划（DSS）学校招收更多持有学生签证的非本地学生。至今已有48所直资学校获批准参与。政府还计划在明年之前为新的国际学校分配土地，以满足非本地家庭的需求。

Hong Kong education chief outlines strategy to become top international study destination | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 19 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong education chief outlines strategy to become top international study destination
Hong Kong's education secretary detailed plans to attract more non-local students, boost university capacity with the Northern Territories University City, and expand the 'Study in Hong Kong' brand. Targets include raising non-local student numbers to 90,000 by 2027/28.
Hong Kong's Secretary for Education outlined the government's strategy to deepen the city's status as an international education hub, aiming to make it a top choice for students worldwide. Speaking in the Legislative Council on 18 November 2026, the secretary detailed a multi-pronged approach that includes expanding university capacity, enhancing support systems, and promoting the 'Study in Hong Kong' brand.
The number of non-local students studying in Hong Kong has risen sharply from 23,100 in the 2023/24 academic year to 30,400 in 2025/26, hailing from over 100 countries and territories. The government has set a target of increasing this figure to approximately 90,000 by the 2026/27 academic year, as outlined in the 2026 Policy Address.
Key initiatives include the establishment of a dedicated 'Study in Hong Kong' task force to coordinate efforts across various government bureaux and departments. The government has also launched the 'Study in Hong Kong' and 'Study Tour Hong Kong' brands, highlighted by the first 'Study in Hong Kong Week' and the hosting of the APAIE 2026 conference, which attracted over 3,500 international education leaders from 72 countries.
To support this growth, the government is expanding scholarship programmes, notably the Belt and Road Scholarship, which will increase from an initial 10 awards to 200 annually by the 2027/28 academic year. Accommodation is being addressed through the 'City-in-Campus' scheme, which by late October 2026 had approved 45 applications to convert commercial buildings into student housing, expected to provide about 11,450 beds.
Visa processes have been streamlined for short-term courses, and the Immigration Department has granted over 53,500 multiple-entry-visa approvals for non-Chinese Hong Kong residents to travel to mainland China, facilitating academic exchanges. The government has also extended the stay period under the IANG (Immigration Arrangement for Non-local Graduates) scheme from 12 to 24 months to help retain talent.
A major component of the strategy is the Northern Territories University City, covering over 1,000 hectares across San Tin, Hung Shui Kiu, and Ta Kwu Ling. Three campus sites in Hung Shui Kiu are now open for applications from eligible institutions. The government has upgraded the steering committee to a 'University City Development and Construction Committee' led by the Chief Secretary to oversee progress.
The 'Study in Hong Kong' brand is also being extended to basic education. A pilot 'Direct Subsidy Expansion' scheme, launched in the 2026/27 school year, allows eligible Direct Subsidy Scheme (DSS) schools to admit more non-local students holding student visas. So far, 48 DSS schools have been approved to participate. The government is also planning to allocate land for new international schools by next year to support the needs of non-local families.
The secretary emphasised that the goal is not merely to be the 'first choice' but to highlight Hong Kong's unique advantages: high-quality education, an international environment, strong safety record, and its role as a bridge between mainland China and the world. The government aims to attract top scholars and students by focusing on these distinctive strengths.

香港冬季节日在中环地标上进行灯光秀 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港冬季节开幕 中环地标灯光秀
香港旅游发展局于 11 月 18 日推出一年一度的“冬季奇观”节，在中环地标上进行灯光投影，直至 1 月初。此次活动也标志着拥有 22 年历史的幻彩咏香江的最后一次表演，其中包括烟花表演。
香港旅游发展局的旗舰年度盛典“香港冬季奇观”于周三启动，从周三晚上到明年一月初，灯光投影将照亮中环几座地标建筑的外墙。
文化体育及旅游局局长罗莎琳达在“香港中环冬季小镇”开幕仪式上表示，冬季小镇还将扩展至尖沙咀和铜锣湾，提供双重冬季灯光体验，与中环的展示相得益彰。她表示，此举旨在让市民和旅客感受香港浓厚的节日气氛。
罗莎琳达还宣布，吉尼斯世界纪录保持者、22岁的《幻彩咏香江》将于周三最后一次演出。最后的表演将融入烟花，为这一经典奇观画上圆满的句号。
她表示，旅游发展局举办的活动包括国际中秋灯会、大坑舞火龙、香港美酒美食节等，深受市民和旅客欢迎。她说，这些活动提升了夜间气氛，刺激了零售和餐饮业，效果明显。

Hong Kong launches winter festival with light shows on Central landmarks
The Hong Kong Tourism Board launched its annual 'Winter Wonders' festival on 18 November, featuring light projections on Central landmarks until early January. The event also marks the final performance of the 22-year-old Symphony of Lights, which will include fireworks.
The Hong Kong Tourism Board's flagship annual festival, 'Hong Kong Winter Wonders', launched on Wednesday, with light projections set to illuminate the facades of several landmark buildings in Central from Wednesday evening until early January next year.
Speaking at the opening ceremony of the 'Hong Kong Winter Town in Central', Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosalia Rosalinda said the winter town will also be expanded to Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay, offering a dual winter light experience that complements the displays in Central. She said the initiative aims to allow residents and visitors to experience Hong Kong's strong festive atmosphere.
Rosalinda also announced that the 22-year-old Symphony of Lights, a Guinness World Record holder, will be performed for the last time on Wednesday. The final show will incorporate fireworks, bringing the classic spectacle to a fitting conclusion.
She noted that the Tourism Board has organised various events, including the International Mid-Autumn Lantern Festival, the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance, and the Hong Kong Wine and Food Festival, which have been well received by residents and tourists. These events, she said, have boosted the nighttime atmosphere and stimulated the retail and dining sectors, with visible results.

香港海关两次行动检获价值680万港元的毒品中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港海关两次行动检获价值680万港元的毒品
香港海关分两次行动检获约11公斤怀疑氯胺酮及一定数量怀疑依托咪酯，估计总市值达680万港元。三名嫌疑人被捕，将于 11 月 19 日出庭。
香港政府于 11 月 18 日宣布，香港海关在两次独立行动中查获了价值约 680 万港元（87 万美元）的涉嫌非法毒品，并逮捕了三人。
在第一个案件中，香港海关与内地海关反走私部队基于情报交流和风险评估进行了联合行动。 10月27日，他们截获了一个从英国经内地寄往香港的包裹，宣称为海盐身体磨砂膏。警方在28个塑料瓶内发现了约11公斤疑似氯胺酮。在一次控制下交付行动后，一名 50 岁的当地妇女于 11 月 17 日在约旦被捕。
在第二起案件中，警员于11月17日在元朗进行缉毒行动时截获两名28岁男子，其中一名是本地人，一名来自内地。这些人被带到附近的一处村屋进行搜查，警方在那里发现了一定数量的疑似依托咪酯，以及疑似毒品制造和包装工具。
在第一起案件中被捕的妇女被指控犯有企图贩运危险药物的罪名。她定于11月19日在九龙城裁判法院出庭。第二起案件中被捕的两名男子被共同指控一项制造危险药物罪和一项贩运危险药物罪。这名当地男子还被指控一项妨碍海关官员的罪名。他们将于11月19日在粉岭裁判法院出庭。
根据《危险药物条例》，制造或贩运危险药物均属严重罪行，一经定罪，最高可被罚款港币500万元及终身监禁。
海关呼吁公众透过24小时热线182 8080、专用电邮帐户[email protected]或网上表格eform.cefs.gov.hk/form/ced002举报怀疑贩毒活动。

Thursday, 19 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong Customs seizes HK$6.8m drugs in two operations
Hong Kong Customs seized about 11kg of suspected ketamine and a quantity of suspected etomidate in two separate operations, with a total estimated street value of HK$6.8 million. Three suspects were arrested and will appear in court on 19 November.
Hong Kong Customs has seized about HK$6.8 million (US$870,000) worth of suspected illegal drugs in two separate operations, arresting three people, the government announced on 18 November.
In the first case, acting on intelligence exchange and risk assessment, Hong Kong Customs and the mainland Chinese customs anti-smuggling unit conducted a joint operation. On 27 October, they intercepted a parcel sent from Britain via the mainland to Hong Kong, declared as sea salt body scrub. Officers found about 11kg of suspected ketamine hidden inside 28 plastic bottles. Following a controlled delivery operation, a 50-year-old local woman was arrested on 17 November in Jordan.
In the second case, officers carrying out an anti-drug operation in Yuen Long on 17 November stopped two 28-year-old men, one local and one from the mainland. The men were taken to a nearby village house for a search, where officers found a quantity of suspected etomidate, along with suspected drug manufacturing and packaging tools.
The woman arrested in the first case has been charged with one count of attempting to traffic in a dangerous drug. She is scheduled to appear at Kowloon City Magistrates' Court on 19 November. The two men arrested in the second case have been jointly charged with one count of manufacturing a dangerous drug and one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug. The local man has also been charged with one count of obstructing a Customs officer. They will appear at Fanling Magistrates' Court on 19 November.
Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, manufacturing or trafficking dangerous drugs are serious offences, carrying a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment upon conviction.
Customs urged the public to report suspected drug trafficking activities via its 24-hour hotline 182 8080, the dedicated email account [email protected], or the online form at eform.cefs.gov.hk/form/ced002.

香港两家奢侈品寄售店关门，老板携逾2000万美元失踪 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港两家奢侈品寄售店关门 老板失踪 身家超2000万美元
奢侈品寄售店 vootic 和 Obsessplanet 突然关门；日本老板和妻子联系不上。超过100名客户面临超过2,000万港元的损失。警方将案件归类为欺诈。
据《星岛日报》姊妹刊物《星岛探索》报道，香港两家奢侈品寄售店突然关门，据报道无法联系到日本店主及其妻子，预计超过 100 名顾客蒙受超过 2000 万港元的损失。
位于铜锣湾和金钟的 Obsessplanet 的商店于周日晚上停止回应顾客，周一（11 月 16 日）这两家商店被发现已关门。顾客表示，他们无法取回寄售的奢侈品或收取未付款项，一些人报告损失达数十万美元。
警方表示，截至周二（11月17日）下午3时，已有37人举报铜锣湾分店涉嫌拖欠寄售款项，涉及约港币1,400万元；而金钟分店则接获六起举报，涉及约港币260万元。案件已列为诈骗案，由湾仔及中环警区重案组跟进调查。

Thursday, 19 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Two luxury consignment shops in Hong Kong shut, owner disappears with over $20m
Luxury consignment shops vootic and Obsessplanet close suddenly; Japanese owner and wife unreachable. Over 100 customers face losses exceeding HK$20 million. Police classify cases as fraud.
More than 100 customers are feared to have suffered losses exceeding HK$20 million after two luxury consignment shops in Hong Kong abruptly shut down, with their Japanese owner and his wife reportedly unreachable, according to Sing Tao Probe, the sister publication of The Standard.
The shops, vootic in Causeway Bay and Obsessplanet in Admiralty, stopped responding to customers on Sunday night, with both outlets found closed on Monday (16 November). Customers said they were unable to retrieve luxury goods left for consignment or collect outstanding payments, with some reporting losses of hundreds of thousands of dollars.
Police said 37 people had reported suspected outstanding consignment payments involving about HK$14 million at the Causeway Bay shop, while six reports involving about HK$2.6 million were received concerning the Admiralty outlet as of 3pm Tuesday (17 November). The cases have been classified as fraud and are being investigated by the Wan Chai and Central district crime squads.

大湾区办事处在香港创业日推广创业机会 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
大湾区办事处于香港创业日推广创业机会
粤港澳大湾区发展办公室在香港创业日展示跨境创业机会，重点展示北领地和深港科技区。
粤港澳大湾区发展办公室在香港创业日推介跨境商机，重点关注北领地和深港创新科技合作区。
该办公室的展位位于香港会议展览中心1E馆（展位号1E-F02），介绍大湾区的发展概况、支持香港青年在区内创业的措施，以及广州大湾区发展促进中心提供的服务等。 11月19日星期四的09:00至18:30和11月20日星期五的09:00至18:00免费入场。有兴趣的参观者可通过香港贸易发展局网站预先登记。
该办公室表示，香港第一个五年规划与国家“十五五”规划一致，其中专门设立了关于大湾区的章节。规划明确指出香港将参与该地区的发展。该办公室一直通过多种渠道宣传大湾区带来的重大机遇。
办事处的摊位还提供限量版纪念品，售完即止。有关大湾区的更多信息，请访问该办公室的专门网站：www.bayarea.gov.hk。

summary: 香港警方捣毁礼品卡诈骗集团，逮捕11人|中国劳工布告栏 星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 香港警方捣毁礼品卡诈骗集团，逮捕 11 名香港警方捣毁一个利用礼品卡诈骗网上购物者的诈骗集团，逮捕 7 名男子和 4 名女子，涉及至少 35 起涉及损失超过 65 万港元的案件。香港警方捣毁一个利用电子产品礼品卡诈骗网上购物者的犯罪集团，逮捕了11名涉案人员
content:
香港警方捣毁礼品卡诈骗集团，逮捕11人|中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港警方捣毁礼品卡诈骗集团逮捕11人
香港警方捣毁一个利用礼品卡诈骗网上购物者的诈骗集团，拘捕7名男子和4名女子，涉及至少35起涉及损失超过65万港元的案件。
香港警方捣毁了一个利用电子产品礼品卡诈骗网上购物者的犯罪集团，逮捕了涉及至少 35 起案件的 11 人。受害者总共损失超过 650,000 港元（83,000 美元）。
据警方介绍，该诈骗团伙收集了大量预先注册的SIM卡，用于在网购平台上创建账户。他们以低于市场价格 10% 至 20% 的价格出售电子产品礼品卡，以引诱受害者将钱转入该犯罪团伙控制的银行账户。收到付款后，他们提供了无效的兑换码。
警方表示，犯罪团伙成员还积极接近销售礼品卡的受害者，诱骗他们交出兑换码，然后切断联系。为减少受害人怀疑，骗徒主动提出会面，并以快速现金方式招募跑腿者进行交易，并承诺支付数百港元。然而，那些完成工作的人通常从未收到承诺的工资。
被捕者包括七男四女，年龄介乎 19 至 74 岁，包括该集团的策划者、注册电话号码和网上购物平台账户的个人，以及该计划中使用的银行账户的持有人。

Hong Kong police dismantle gift card scam syndicate, arrest 11
Hong Kong police have dismantled a scam syndicate that used gift cards to defraud online shoppers, arresting 7 men and 4 women in connection with at least 35 cases involving losses exceeding HK$650,000.
Hong Kong police have dismantled a criminal syndicate that used electronic product gift cards to defraud online shoppers, arresting 11 people in connection with at least 35 cases. Victims lost more than HK$650,000 (US$83,000) in total.
According to police, the fraud ring collected large numbers of pre-registered SIM cards to create accounts on online shopping platforms. They listed electronic product gift cards for sale at 10 to 20 per cent below market prices to lure victims into transferring money to bank accounts controlled by the syndicate. After receiving payment, they provided invalid redemption codes.
Police said syndicate members also actively approached victims who were selling gift cards, tricking them into handing over redemption codes before cutting off contact. To reduce victims' suspicion, the scammers offered to meet in person and recruited runners on a quick-cash basis to carry out transactions, promising them several hundred Hong Kong dollars in payment. However, those who completed the jobs usually never received their promised pay.
The arrested individuals — seven men and four women aged between 19 and 74 — included the syndicate's mastermind, individuals who registered phone numbers and online shopping platform accounts, and holders of bank accounts used in the scheme.

summary: 香港立法会辩论任命英国最高法院法官|中国劳工公告牌 星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港立法会就英国最高法院法官的任命进行辩论 香港政务司司长敦促立法会议员支持重新任命理查兹大法官为终审法院非常任法官，突显香港在“一国两制”原则下作为国际法律中心的角色。辩论凸显司法机构的独立性 香港政务司司长呼吁立法会
content:
香港立法会辩论任命英国最高法院法官|中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港立法会辩论任命英国最高法院法官
香港政务司司长敦促立法会议员支持重新任命理查兹大法官为终审法院非常任法官，强调香港在“一国两制”原则下作为国际法律中心的作用。这场辩论凸显了司法部门的独立性
香港政务司司长呼吁立法会批准重新任命来自另一个普通法司法管辖区的理查兹大法官为终审法院非常任法官。布政司在 2026 年 11 月 18 日的辩论中发表讲话，感谢立法者对任命的看法和支持。
政务司司长强调，国家“十五五”规划已明确肯定香港的国际法律中心地位。他指出，香港第一个五年计划旨在发挥普通法体系的独特优势，深化其作为国际法律中心的作用。
布政司表示，理查兹大法官与其他在职非常任普通法法官一样，是一位著名的普通法专家。他补充说，任命这些杰出的海外法官表明了他们对香港司法制度和独立性的信心，并促进了不同司法管辖区法官之间的相互交流和提高。
政务司司长强调，律政司的年度旗舰活动“香港法律周”展示了香港作为国际法律中心的领先地位。他指出，国际统一私法协会亚太联络处在香港设立，意味着国际私法的三个“姐妹”——统一私法协会、海牙国际私法会议和联合国国际贸易法委员会——现在都将总部设在香港。这与国际调解研究所等其他国际组织一起，表明了国际社会对香港法治的信心。
回应立法会议员关于委任更多普通法适用地区法官的建议时，政务司司长解释，《基本法》和《香港终审法院条例》允许法院根据需要邀请来自其他普通法适用地区的法官。他说，司法机构根据司法和专业能力选拔法官，目前法院有五名来自英国、澳大利亚和新西兰的非常任普通法法官。他补充说，来自其他普通法司法管辖区的顶尖候选人也将被考虑。
政务司司长强调，司法机构坚持法治和独立的司法制度，并受《基本法》保障。他表示，终审法院已成为普通法世界领先的终审法院，非常任普通法法官在刑法、民事诉讼、行政法、仲裁、商法、土地法和税法等领域做出了广泛认可的贡献。

Hong Kong LegCo debates appointment of UK judge to top court
Hong Kong's Chief Secretary urged lawmakers to back the reappointment of Lord Justice Richards as a non-permanent judge of the Court of Final Appeal, highlighting the city's role as an international legal hub under the 'one country, two systems' principle. The debate underscored the judiciary's inde
Hong Kong's Chief Secretary has called on the Legislative Council to approve the reappointment of Lord Justice Richards as a non-permanent judge of the Court of Final Appeal from another common law jurisdiction. Speaking during a debate on 18 November 2026, the Chief Secretary thanked lawmakers for their views and support for the appointment.
The Chief Secretary stressed that Hong Kong's status as an international legal centre has been explicitly endorsed in the national 15th Five-Year Plan. He noted that the city's first five-year plan aims to leverage the unique advantages of the common law system to deepen its role as an international legal hub.
Lord Justice Richards, like other serving non-permanent common law judges, is a renowned common law expert, the Chief Secretary said. Appointing such eminent overseas judges demonstrates their confidence in Hong Kong's judicial system and independence, and promotes mutual exchange and improvement among judges from different jurisdictions, he added.
The Chief Secretary highlighted that the Department of Justice's annual flagship event, Hong Kong Legal Week, showcased the city's leading position as an international legal hub. He noted that the opening of the UNIDROIT Asia-Pacific Liaison Office in Hong Kong means all three 'sisters' of international private law – UNIDROIT, the Hague Conference on Private International Law, and the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law – are now based in the city. This, along with other international organisations like the International Mediation Institute, demonstrates international confidence in Hong Kong's rule of law.
Responding to a lawmaker's suggestion about appointing judges from more common law jurisdictions, the Chief Secretary explained that the Basic Law and the Hong Kong Court of Final Appeal Ordinance allow the court to invite judges from other common law jurisdictions as needed. He said the judiciary selects judges based on their judicial and professional abilities, and currently the court has five non-permanent common law judges from the UK, Australia and New Zealand. Top candidates from other common law jurisdictions would also be considered, he added.
The Chief Secretary emphasised that the judiciary upholds the rule of law and an independent judicial system protected by the Basic Law. He said the Court of Final Appeal has established itself as a leading final appellate court in the common law world, with the non-permanent common law judges making widely recognised contributions in areas including criminal law, civil procedure, administrative law, arbitration, commercial law, land law and tax law.

summary: 香港与智利在亚太经合组织峰会上签署工作假期协议中国劳工公告牌 星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港和智利在亚太经合组织峰会上签署工作假期协议 香港和智利周三在深圳亚太经合组织峰会上签署工作假期协议。该协议每年允许双方最多 100 名年轻人在对方生活、工作和学习长达 12 个月。这是香港首个与拉丁美洲伙伴合作的此类计划。香港与智利周三在H见证下签署工作假期协议
content:
香港与智利在亚太经合组织峰会上签署工作假期协议中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港与智利在亚太经合组织峰会签署工作假期协议
香港与智利周三在深圳亚太经合组织峰会上签署工作假期协议。该协议每年允许双方最多 100 名年轻人在对方生活、工作和学习长达 12 个月。这是香港首个与拉丁美洲伙伴合作的此类计划。
香港与智利周三在香港行政长官李家超和智利总统加布里埃尔·博里奇的见证下签署工作假期协议。该文件是由香港劳工及福利局局长孙宇晨和智利外交部长弗朗西斯科·佩雷斯·麦肯纳在深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议期间签署的。
孙对计划的成立表示欢迎，并称智利是香港在拉丁美洲的首个工作假期合作伙伴。他表示，该项目将为双方年轻人提供体验不同文化中的生活和工作、开阔视野的机会。
佩雷斯·麦肯纳表示，他很高兴为智利和香港年轻人提供体验彼此当地生活的新机会。他表示，香港独特的东西方文化交融、国际视野和充满活力的经济将为智利青年提供丰富的经历，而香港青年则可以探索智利丰富的文化、热情好客和自然美景，促进相互了解和人文交流。
智利成为香港第15个双边工作假期伙伴。自2001年起，香港已与新西兰、澳大利亚、爱尔兰、德国、日本、加拿大、韩国、法国、英国、奥地利、匈牙利、瑞典、荷兰和意大利签订了类似的协定，其中最后一项尚未生效。至今已有超过109,000名香港年轻人受惠于该计划。
根据香港与智利协议，双方青少年均可申请签证在对方逗留最多12个月。在此期间，他们可以从事短期工作来资助旅行或参加短期课程。双方每年将提供100个名额。
有关香港及智利申请人签证申请程序的详情，将于稍后在智利入境事务处及香港入境事务处网站公布。

Hong Kong and Chile sign working holiday deal at Apec summit
Hong Kong and Chile signed a working holiday agreement on Wednesday at the Apec summit in Shenzhen. The pact allows up to 100 young people from each side annually to live, work and study in the other for up to 12 months. It is Hong Kong's first such scheme with a Latin American partner.
Hong Kong and Chile signed a working holiday agreement on Wednesday, witnessed by Hong Kong Chief Executive Lee Ka-chiu and Chilean President Gabriel Boric. The document was inked by Hong Kong's Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun and Chilean Foreign Minister Francisco Pérez Mackenna on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) leaders' informal meeting in Shenzhen.
Sun welcomed the establishment of the scheme, calling Chile Hong Kong's first working holiday partner in Latin America. He said the programme would give young people from both sides a chance to broaden their horizons by experiencing life and work in a different culture.
Pérez Mackenna said he was delighted to offer new opportunities for young Chileans and Hongkongers to experience each other's local life. He noted that Hong Kong's unique blend of Eastern and Western cultures, international outlook and dynamic economy would provide a rich experience for Chilean youth, while Hong Kong youngsters could explore Chile's rich culture, hospitality and natural beauty, fostering mutual understanding and people-to-people exchanges.
Chile becomes Hong Kong's 15th bilateral working holiday partner. Since 2001, Hong Kong has concluded similar pacts with New Zealand, Australia, Ireland, Germany, Japan, Canada, South Korea, France, Britain, Austria, Hungary, Sweden, the Netherlands and Italy, the last of which is yet to take effect. More than 109,000 Hong Kong young people have benefited from the scheme so far.
Under the Hong Kong-Chile agreement, young people from each side may apply for a visa to stay in the other for up to 12 months. During that time, they can take short-term work to fund their travel or enrol in short courses. Each side will offer 100 places per year.
Details on visa application procedures for Hong Kong and Chilean applicants will be published later on the websites of Chile's immigration service and Hong Kong's Immigration Department.

title: 美國會報告：中共靠英偉達芯片提升AI戰力

content:
USCC的報告顯示，中共除了利用英偉達芯片提升經濟實力，也用來增加軍隊的人工智能（AI）戰力。圖為英偉達公司標誌。(Shutterstock)
【大紀元2026年11月18日訊】（大紀元記者任義綜合報導）美國國會美中經濟與安全審查委員會（USCC）發布的報告顯示，中共除了利用英偉達芯片提升經濟實力，也用來增加軍隊的人工智能（AI）戰力。
美中經濟與安全審查委員會（USCC）11月18日發布的《2026年提交國會年度報告》顯示，中共規避美國的出口管制，以獲取支撐其智能化戰略的最先進芯片。
報告指出，中國企業已透過馬來西亞等第三國的資料中心，遠端使用英偉達芯片的運算資源。這顯示美國限制先進芯片出口後，中國企業仍有其它管道取得相關算力。
中國本土產品與美國芯片仍存在技術差距，包括華為昇腾（Ascend）、寒武紀思元（Siyuan）系列在內的中國AI芯片，仍落後於英偉達、超微（AMD）等美國企業的先進產品。中國半導體發展尚未突破的瓶頸包括尖端邏輯芯片製造、內存、半導體製造設備，以及英偉達CUDA軟件生態體系。
報告指出，中共軍隊正試圖規避美國出口管制，積極尋求取得英偉達最先進的芯片，作為推動「智能化戰爭（intelligentized warfare）」的核心硬件基礎，以發展使用人工智能（AI）的軍事能力。中共正將AI技術整合至武器系統、指揮與控制、殺傷鏈（kill chains）以及軍事後勤保障中，以提升戰場態勢感知與作戰效能。
報告引用了喬治城大學安全與新興技術中心（CSET）於2026年4月發布的一項評估研究。研究人員分析了過去幾年間大量的中共軍隊公開採購中標文件，發現多份採購清單直接點名尋求英偉達高端AI芯片。除了傳統軍工單位外，大量與中共軍隊關係密切的高校（如「國防七子」院校）、科研院所及軍民兩用企業均在採購名單之列，這顯示出民用或科研渠道採購的算力硬件正通過「軍民融合」體系向軍事領域轉化。
報告認為，美國對先進芯片實施的出口管制，是中共仍面臨顯著算力差距的重要原因。不過，中國企業透過第三國資料中心遠端使用芯片的方式，也凸顯出口管制面臨的執行挑戰。
這份報告發布之際，正值英偉達首席執行官黃仁勳因被曝與一名疑似中共女間諜黃樂有染而辭職之際。黃樂當時是總部位於新加坡的數據公司Megaspeed的一名高管，Megaspeed是英偉達的亞太主要合作夥伴之一，並對外提供GPU算力租賃與雲服務。 美國調查人員正在調查該公司是否可能將英偉達的芯片轉移到中國。
英偉達曾表示，美國實施的出口管制實際上已將其排除在中國人工智能數據中心市場之外，並批評相關政策導致美國失去一個重要市場。
據路透社11月18日報導，一項調查顯示，儘管華盛頓一直試圖限制北京獲取這些推動全球人工智能快速發展的關鍵產品，中國仍有超過230億元人民幣的計算基礎設施項目與英偉達技術相關。這些項目遍布中國各地，既包括沿海科技中心，也包括西部偏遠省份，顯示出市場對英偉達產品需求依然旺盛。
報導說，經審查150多份招標公告、投資規劃文件、建設合同以及中國企業發布的信息後，識別出一系列相關項目和設備採購合同。除了中國大型科技企業外，英偉達產品也廣泛出現在地方政府支持的企業、高校以及區域計算中心之中。
例如遭美國列入出口管制黑名單的中國西北工業大學，今年10月21日發布公告，透過中國供應商採購兩顆英偉達H200人工智能芯片，總價87.47萬元人民幣。西北工業大學位於西安，是中共軍工院校「國防七子」之一，研究領域包括軍用飛機、導彈及衛星。
H200可用於訓練及運行先進AI系統。川普（特朗普）政府今年1月開始對部分H200對華出口申請逐案審查。
在黃仁勳辭職後，接任臨時首席執行官的英偉達首席財務官科萊特‧克雷斯（Colette Kress）11月17日在財報電話會議上證實，公司已停止向中國出貨H200芯片。+

朝鲜在俄罗斯-乌克兰战争中的局势
《外交家》作者郭美玲定期与全球主题专家、政策从业者和战略思想家交流，以获取他们对美国亚洲政策的不同见解。与 Pekka Virkki 博士（Mission Grey 联合创始人、记者、《后芬兰化的尸检：俄罗斯欧洲绥靖的根源》（同上，2026）一书的作者）的这次对话是“跨太平洋观点洞察系列”的第 536 次对话。
分析芬兰化和欧洲对俄罗斯绥靖政策的历史根源。
芬兰化起源于权力的极端不对称。第二次世界大战后，芬兰领土缩小，军事脆弱，并受到苏联的影响。 1948 年的《友好合作互助条约》将这种不对称性制度化，但芬兰并没有完全沦为苏联卫星国。芬兰的政策力求避免与莫斯科发生对抗，同时在情况允许的情况下保留尽可能多的主权和国内自治。
关键的发展是从外部约束向内部自我约束的转变。政治领导人、官员、企业和部分媒体越来越期待苏联的反应。苏联的影响力通过影响力代理人网络和非正式接触得到了加强。正式的民主制度得以保留，但政治上可行的选择范围却缩小了。
冷战后欧洲对俄罗斯的包容是在不同的情况下出现的，但再现了类似的机制：相信经济相互依赖将缓和俄罗斯的行为、日益增长的能源依赖、与俄罗斯利益相关的精英网络以及对警告信号的反复忽视，特别是在2008年格鲁吉亚战争和2014年乌克兰战争之后。这些因素相互强化。尽管战略风险不断增加，但商业激励和对抗的直接成本一再有利于和解，最终为俄罗斯 2022 年再次入侵乌克兰铺平了道路。
更广泛的教训是路径依赖。芬兰化并不意味着迅速、明确地放弃主权，而是通过个人可防御的妥协——选择性沉默、特殊安排、经济正常化和延迟反应——来发展，从而逐步降低进一步妥协的门槛。
描述一下台湾芬兰化的合理情景。
人们不时地提出芬兰化作为台湾安全困境的解决方案。布鲁斯·吉利 (Bruce Gilley) 2010 年的论点体现了自由国际主义版本：经济一体化、政治互动和和解可以减少冲突，并有可能使中国社会化，甚至自由化。这类似于欧洲冷战后俄罗斯政策的部分假设。

What Would the ‘Finlandization’ of Taiwan Look Like? – The Diplomat
What the New Democratic Congressional Majority Means for Trump’s Asia-Pacific Policy
ASEAN and APEC: Trump’s Real Lame-Duck Test Is in Asia

Why Aung San Suu Kyi Is Still the ‘Perfect Hostage’
Taipei’s Voters Aren’t Choosing Independence or Unification
For More Than 20 Years, Bangladesh’s One Constant Has Been Political Violence
North Korea’s State of Play in the Russia-Ukraine War
The Diplomat author Mercy Kuo regularly engages subject matter experts, policy practitioners, and strategic thinkers across the globe for their diverse insights into U.S. Asia policy. This conversation with Dr. Pekka Virkki – co-founder of Mission Grey, journalist, and author of “Autopsy of Post-Finlandization: The Roots of the European Appeasement of Russia” (ibidem 2026) – is the 536th in “The Trans-Pacific View Insight Series.”
Analyze the historical roots of Finlandization and European appeasement of Russia.
Finlandization originated in an extreme asymmetry of power. After the Second World War, Finland was territorially diminished, militarily vulnerable, and exposed to the Soviet Union. The 1948 Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation, and Mutual Assistance institutionalized this asymmetry without reducing Finland to a full Soviet satellite. Finnish policy sought to avoid confrontation with Moscow while preserving as much sovereignty and domestic autonomy as circumstances permitted.
The crucial development was the transition from external restraint to internal self-restraint. Political leaders, officials, businesses, and parts of the media increasingly anticipated Soviet reactions. Soviet influence was reinforced by networks of agents of influence and informal contacts. Formal democratic institutions survived, but the range of politically feasible choices narrowed.
Post-Cold War European accommodation of Russia arose under different circumstances but reproduced comparable mechanisms: confidence that economic interdependence would moderate Russian behavior, growing energy dependence, elite networks linked to Russian interests, and repeated discounting of warning signs, particularly after the wars in Georgia in 2008 and Ukraine from 2014. These factors reinforced one another. Commercial incentives and the immediate costs of confrontation repeatedly favored accommodation despite mounting strategic risks, ultimately paving the way for renewed Russian aggression against Ukraine in 2022.
The broader lesson is one of path dependence. Finlandization does not mean a rapid, explicit surrender of sovereignty, but it develops through individually defensible compromises – selective silence, exceptional arrangements, economic normalization, and delayed responses – which progressively lower the threshold for further accommodation.
Describe what a plausible scenario of the Finlandization of Taiwan would look like.
Finlandization has periodically been proposed as a solution to Taiwan’s security dilemma. Bruce Gilley’s 2010 argument exemplified a liberal-internationalist version: economic integration, political interaction, and accommodation could reduce conflict and potentially socialize, even liberalize, China. This resembles assumptions that also informed parts of Europe’s post-Cold War Russia policy.
A contemporary Finlandization scenario would probably be more coercive and incremental. It would not initially entail annexation or “one country, two systems.” Taiwan could retain elections, armed forces, democratic institutions, and de facto self-government while gradually losing strategic freedom of action.
The process could proceed through four stages. First, persistent Chinese military, maritime, cyber, economic, informational, and legal pressure normalizes coercion below the threshold of war. Second, Taiwan’s partners increasingly prioritize crisis management, encouraging Taipei to exercise restraint. Third, external restraint becomes internalized: Taiwanese political and economic elites advocate reduced defense visibility, softer sovereignty rhetoric, closer economic relations with China, and limitations on foreign security cooperation. Finally, Beijing acquires an informal veto over politically feasible Taiwanese choices without directly governing Taiwan.
The paradoxical endpoint would be a scenario where Taiwan remains democratic but is no longer fully strategically autonomous.
There is, however, no guarantee that democracy and accommodation would remain confined within these limits. Concessions do not in themselves preclude further demands, or ultimately even military aggression. From the Soviet perspective, this was also part of the logic of Finlandization: “peaceful coexistence as an instrument of class struggle.” Finnish interpretations tended to retain the “peaceful coexistence” while conveniently leaving out its Soviet qualifier: “as an instrument of class struggle.”
What domestic conditions would cause the Finlandization of Taiwan?
The most important domestic condition would be a loss of confidence in the utility of resistance. Accommodation becomes politically attractive if substantial parts of Taiwanese society conclude that resisting China carries unacceptable humanitarian or economic costs while American support cannot ultimately be relied upon.
A second condition would be elite convergence. China-exposed businesses, accommodation-oriented politicians, retired officials, media actors, and local political networks could collectively redefine self-restraint as prudent statecraft rather than capitulation. This would be reinforced by weakened societal capacity to identify covert financing, disinformation, cyber interference, and elite capture.
Economic constituencies would also matter. Mainland-exposed manufacturers, taishang [Taiwanese businesspeople who operate on the mainland] networks, tourism and agricultural interests, and local patronage networks could translate economic losses into demands for political accommodation. They would not need to support unification; it would be sufficient for them to conclude that sustained confrontation is economically intolerable.
What external factors would precipitate the Finlandization of Taiwan?
The principal external driver would be sustained Chinese coercion calibrated below the threshold of war. Beijing would seek to increase the costs of Taiwan exercising its autonomy without creating a clear trigger for external military intervention. PLA operations, coast guard activity, cyber operations, economic coercion, and legal warfare could cumulatively normalize Chinese pressure.
A successful quasi-blockade could constitute a major turning point. Maritime inspections, temporary exclusion zones, customs measures, or “quarantine” arrangements could demonstrate China’s ability to disrupt Taiwanese commerce without provoking an effective international response.
Equally important would be declining confidence in external support. U.S.-China strategic bargaining could implicitly subordinate Taiwan to broader priorities in trade, technology, or bilateral stability. Reduced arms transfers or political contacts would magnify this effect. Regional hedging by Japan, Southeast Asian countries, or European states could further convince Taiwanese actors that their international room for maneuver was contracting.
Identify real-time signals that could indicate the emergence of a Finlandization-of-Taiwan scenario.
No individual indicator would demonstrate Finlandization. The important signal would be convergence across military, international, political, and economic domains. Current trends – high defense expenditure, investment in unmanned and AI capabilities, whole-of-society resilience, and substantial willingness to defend Taiwan – point in the opposite direction. Finlandization would therefore require a reversal across several variables.
The principal indicators would be sustained intensification of Chinese coercion, weakening or increasing ambiguity in U.S. military support and arms deliveries, a shift in Taiwanese political language from deterrence toward reassurance through restraint, and growing advocacy by political and business elites for deeper mainland ties and acceptance of Beijing-defined constraints. Particular attention should be paid to intermediaries capable of translating Chinese preferences into domestically legitimate arguments.
The critical warning sign is therefore not simply more Chinese pressure, but the interaction of prolonged Chinese coercion, allied ambiguity, and Taiwanese domestic adaptation. Finlandization should be understood as a process rather than a predetermined settlement. Its defining threshold is reached when anticipated Chinese reactions begin to constrain Taiwanese choices without Beijing having to impose those constraints directly.

content:
日本首相高市在APEC接受中国退休特使的低级别欢迎中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 19 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
日本首相高市在APEC接受中国退休特使的低级欢迎
日本首相高市早苗出席亚太经合组织峰会时在深圳机场受到了一位退休中国外交官的迎接，这一礼遇比其他领导人要低。此次招待会反映出去年高一发表台湾言论后中日关系紧张，预计习高一不会举行会晤。
日本首相高市早苗周三下午抵达深圳机场出席亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议，中国前驻希腊大使章启月热情迎接，与其他出席峰会的领导人相比，接待级别较低。
电视画面显示，67 岁的张正在欢迎高一。张此前曾担任外交部发言人、驻印度尼西亚大使和驻纽约总领事，现已退休五年。她以“外交部礼宾大使”的身份接待了高市，并与广东省政协主席林克清、中国驻韩国大使戴兵一起迎接韩国总统李在明。
当晚的欢迎宴会上，习近平主席同高市一一握手。据彭博社等媒体报道，高一在宴会上向习主席说了几句话，但习主席只是笑笑，没有回应。合影结束后，高一离开时，她和习近平互相点了点头。
出席APEC峰会的领导人主要受到现任正部级官员广东省人大常委会主任黄楚平、广东省政协主席林克清的接见。一位退休局级官员亲自迎接日本政府首脑的礼节明显低于其他领导人。
高市去年11月发表的“台湾突发事件”言论使中日关系急剧恶化，外界普遍预计她不会在这次峰会上与习近平举行会晤。

Japan PM Takaichi receives low-level welcome from retired Chinese envoy at APEC | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 19 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Japan PM Takaichi receives low-level welcome from retired Chinese envoy at APEC
Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi was greeted by a retired Chinese diplomat at Shenzhen airport for the APEC summit, a lower protocol than other leaders. The reception reflects strained China-Japan ties after Takaichi's Taiwan remarks last year, and a Xi-Takaichi meeting is not expected.
Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi arrived at Shenzhen airport on Wednesday afternoon for the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting, where she was greeted by retired former Chinese ambassador to Greece Zhang Qiyue, a lower-level reception than that given to other leaders attending the summit.
Television footage showed Zhang, 67, welcoming Takaichi. Zhang previously served as a Foreign Ministry spokesperson, ambassador to Indonesia and consul-general in New York, and has been retired for five years. She received Takaichi in her capacity as a 'Foreign Ministry protocol ambassador,' and also joined Guangdong Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference Chairman Lin Keqing and Chinese Ambassador to South Korea Dai Bing in welcoming South Korean President Lee Jae-myung.
At the welcome banquet in the evening, President Xi Xiaoming shook hands with Takaichi. According to Bloomberg and other media, Takaichi said a few words to Xi at the banquet, but Xi only smiled without responding. After the group photo, as Takaichi left, she and Xi nodded to each other.
Leaders attending the APEC summit were mainly received by Guangdong Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Director Huang Chuping and CPPCC Guangdong Provincial Committee Chairman Lin Keqing, both incumbent ministerial-level officials. The arrangement of a retired bureau-level official to individually welcome the Japanese head of government was noticeably lower in protocol than for other leaders.
Takaichi's 'Taiwan contingency' remarks last November sharply worsened China-Japan relations, and it is widely expected she will not hold a meeting with Xi during this summit.
